parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the kettle is a circular metallic cover made of stainless steel, fitting snugly on top of the kettle body.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents heat and steam from escaping while boiling water and can be removed to fill or clean the kettle.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the kettle.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle is an arched component made of heat-resistant plastic, attached to the top of the kettle.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to safely lift and pour the kettle without touching the hot metal body.
parts.Movement_description: It may pivot slightly depending on the design but is generally fixed for stability.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the kettle, made of stainless steel with a spout for pouring.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and heats the water, transferring heat efficiently from the heat source to the liquid.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use but can be tilted when pouring.
